ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious File Created in Outlook Temporary Directory
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the creation of files with suspicious file extensions in the temporary directory that Outlook uses when opening attachments.
This can be used to detect spear-phishing campaigns that use suspicious files as attachments, which may contain malicious code.

sequences.query: ((file_path = RGX("\\\.cpl$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.iso$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.rdp$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.svg$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vba$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbs$")) AND ((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Packages\\\\Microsoft\\\.Outlook\\_.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\Olk\\\\Attachments\\\\.*")) OR (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Content\\\.Outlook\\\\.*"))))
